    Special-biserial algebras up to Morita equivalence #

    The frozen manuscript calls an algebra special biserial when its basic algebra admits a special-biserial bound-quiver presentation. This file records that convention literally: a witness consists of a Morita-equivalent algebra and the exact bound-quiver presentation from BoundQuiverPresentation. Such a bound-quiver algebra is itself the chosen basic representative, so basicness is not stored as a redundant field.
